title: 009 毁了温玉010 逃出妖窟
content_zh:
：杨鲤正难受至极，突然听到经文，初时还不知道床上的妖尸又要使什么坏。
他天资聪颖，悟性颇高，连听了几句，一下子明白了其中意涵。
第一句的意思是：人身体有手太阴肺经，每日酉时以后，肺中真液下降至肾，藏于肾中。
便是“太阴藏其真”
子时肾气发动，卯时到肝，“厥阴”
指足厥阴肝经，肝内藏魂。
所以叫做“抽而为厥阴，肾气养肝魂”
管明晦的经文继续传到他的脑海里：“月魄藏盛甲，光耀满乾坤。
回火焚玄道，自此见真阴。
急捉玄阴气，撞开黄庭门……”
杨鲤只觉得这经文意思自己全都能听懂，分明也是正经的道家一脉。
只是炼法和行功路线颇有不同，其中玄妙之处，仿佛远远胜过自己过去所学。
崔海客作为海外散修，旁门一类，其功法水平有限，修行百年，不过炼成一颗青萍金丹，位业止步于太乙散数，未入真流，连真正的长生不老也做不到。
管明晦的玄阴大法，却是这世上顶级功法之一！
人皆乐生恶死，从古至今，人们都在竭尽所能寻求各种长生之法。
上古之时，还没有成系统的修炼体系，对于长生之法尚在探索阶段。
由于不断失败，人们无法在活着时候获得长生，就将希望寄托在死后。
他们汲取月亮精华，淬炼元神，洗炼形体。
待到寿命终了时，以秘法将魂魄强行留在身体里面，使两者相合，不飞不散，再用特殊的手法安葬在风水绝佳之地，继续吸收地气龙脉精华。
等到了特定时候，便能复活重生。

后来很多皇家贵族，用金衣玉俑装殓尸体，再配合黄肠题凑等方式下葬，保持尸身不腐，期待着百年之后复活，都属于这一脉修法在凡间的变种。
此法属于各家的共法，许多人都会，但大多无法让人真正复活，即使最终活过来，也会变成妖尸。
天淫教主于此道最为擅长，自创了许多厉害的功法。
他前后经历过八次死而复生，非佛非道非魔，于三教之外独树一帜，接连渡过三次大天劫，十次小天劫，纵横天下，所向披靡。
一概高僧神尼、真人剑仙、魔王教主，全都拿他没有办法。
如果再被他渡过一次大天劫，就能修成可以媲美金仙的那般万劫不坏之体！
也是他太过肆意妄为，最后恶贯满盈，触发了大天诛，形神俱灭。
得了个真正意义上的天诛地灭！
他传下来的功法，崔海客再修炼一千年，也摸不到一点边！
饶是杨鲤聪慧，一时间也难以全部理解。
管明晦不知道他在想什么，但能够清晰地感知到他体内气血运行的情况。
发现他不懂，就停下来讲解几句：“任脉走心，心属火，应红色，为赤道。
督脉通肾，肾属水，应黑色，为玄道。
将你前面积累的太阴真气从头顶灌入督脉，逆转周天，向下入肾，激发出来的即为玄阴真气，用巽风疾吹送入黄庭，武火烹炼……”
杨鲤依法修炼，果然顺畅无比，不但将全身的太阴精血调动起来，淬炼肉身，还炼出来一缕玄阴真气，最终导入丹田。
果然是个聪明孩子！
管明晦暗暗感叹：我要是穿越成三仙二老，修的是玄门正宗的九天玄经，再提出要收他为徒，他肯定激动兴奋，当场磕头拜师。
可惜我落在谷辰身上，命中注定跟峨眉派不共戴天，跟天下正教势不两立。
不过既来之则安之，老谷虽然不是个好东西，却给我留下了这样一大笔遗产。
content_en:
: Yang Li was feeling extremely uncomfortable when he suddenly heard the scriptures. At first, he didn’t know what harm the monster corpse on the bed was going to do.
He is very talented and has a high level of understanding. After listening to a few sentences, he suddenly understood the meaning.
The meaning of the first sentence is: The human body has the Hand-Taiyin Lung Meridian. After the Unitary Time every day, the true liquid in the lungs drops to the kidneys and is stored in the kidneys.
It is "Taiyin hides its true nature"
Kidney qi activates at Zi time and reaches the liver at Mao time, "Jueyin"
Refers to the Jueyin Liver Meridian of the Foot, where the soul is stored in the liver.
That’s why it’s called “pull out the Yin, and the kidney qi nourishes the liver and soul.”
Guan Minghui's scriptures continued to reach his mind: "The soul of the moon hides in the armor, and its radiance fills the universe.
The returning fire burns the Xuandao, and from then on the true Yin is seen.
Eager to capture Xuan Yin's energy, he knocked open the Huangting Gate..."
Yang Li only felt that he could understand all the meaning of this scripture, and it was clearly a serious Taoist lineage.
It's just that the practice and practice routes are quite different, and the mystery in them seems to be far better than what I have learned in the past.
As an overseas casual cultivator, Cui Haike is a side sect. His skill level is limited. He has practiced for a hundred years, but he has only refined a Qingping Golden Pill. His career has stopped at Taiyi Sanshu. He has not entered the true stream, and he cannot even achieve true immortality.
Guan Minghui's Xuanyin Dafa is one of the top techniques in the world!
Everyone enjoys life and hates death. From ancient times to the present, people have tried their best to seek various methods of immortality.
In ancient times, there was no systematic cultivation system, and the method of immortality was still in the exploratory stage.
Due to constant failures, people cannot achieve immortality while alive, so they place their hopes on death.
They absorb the essence of the moon, temper their souls, and refine their bodies.
When the life is over, the soul will be forced to stay in the body using secret methods, so that the two will be integrated and neither fly nor separate. Then, special techniques will be used to bury it in a place with excellent Feng Shui, and continue to absorb the essence of the earth's energy and dragon veins.
When a certain time comes, you can be resurrected and reborn.
Later, many royal nobles used gold and jade figurines to bury the body, and then buried it with methods such as yellow intestines to keep the body from decaying and look forward to resurrection a hundred years later. These are all variations of this line of practice in the mortal world.
This method is common to all families. Many people know it, but most of them cannot truly resurrect people. Even if they finally come back to life, they will turn into monster corpses.
The leader of Tianyuan is the best at this, and has created many powerful techniques of his own.
He has experienced death and resurrection eight times. He is neither a Buddha nor a Taoist nor a demon. He is unique among the three religions. He has survived three major tribulations and ten minor tribulations. He dominates the world and is invincible.
All the eminent monks, gods, nuns, real-life swordsmen, and demon kings can't do anything to him.
If he survives another great calamity, he will be able to cultivate a body that is as indestructible as the Golden Immortal!
It was also because he acted too wantonly, and in the end he was so full of evil that he triggered the Great Heavenly Punishment, destroying both body and spirit.
Got a real sense of annihilation!
Even if Cui Haike practiced for a thousand years, he still wouldn't be able to get the slightest edge on the skills he passed down!
Even though Yang Li was smart, it was difficult for him to understand everything at once.
Guan Minghui didn't know what he was thinking, but he could clearly sense the flow of qi and blood in his body.
Finding that he didn't understand, he stopped and explained a few words: "The Ren channel leads to the heart. The heart belongs to fire, so it should be red, which is the equator.
The Du Vessel leads to the kidneys. The kidneys belong to water and should be black, which is the mysterious path.
Pour the Taiyin Qi accumulated in front of you from the top of your head into the Du Vein, reverse the flow around the sky, and go down to the kidneys. What is stimulated is the Xuanyin Qi, which will be blown into the Huangting by the Sunda Wind and cooked with martial fire..."
Yang Li practiced according to the law, and it turned out to be extremely smooth. Not only did he mobilize the taiyin essence and blood throughout his body to temper his body, he also refined a ray of mysterious yin true energy, which was finally introduced into the dantian.
He is indeed a smart boy!
Guan Minghui sighed secretly: If I traveled through time and became the Three Immortals and Two Elders, and practiced the Nine Heavens Xuan Sutra of Xuanmen, and then proposed to accept him as my disciple, he would definitely be excited and kowtow to become my disciple on the spot.
It's a pity that I fell in love with Gu Chen. I am destined to be at odds with the Emei sect and the world.Orthodoxy is irreconcilable.
But let's make peace with what we have come. Although Lao Gu was not a good person, he left me such a large legacy.
